fruitList: [crash] laya ONNX SIGSEGV reproduced (runs 1+3; 3rd independent session incl. gate63 attempt 1): SEGV_MAPERR addr 0x0 on the laya-shadow thread in libonnxruntime OrtSession.run at run-end settle/close — races with session close or late forwards. The harness survives long enough to write all evidence, but the APP process dies. ARCHITECTURAL (native ORT on emulated x86 + close race) — NOT fixed; keep shadow OFF on this AVD outside dedicated shadow gates (phase-6 blocker re-confirmed); Gate 8.4 on a device saw zero crashes in ~8 runs. Owner UAT on a real device should be unaffected but this is the top emulator finding.

[wire] FIXED: provider 2-decimal probability rounding (6/37 run-1 rows sum to 0.99) threw 'KL: teacher distribution is not normalized (Sigma p = 0.99, tolerance 1e-6)' out of the joined-view read — joined coverage/agreement degraded to the in-memory fallback exactly on live data (run 1: coverage reported 0.0 despite 24 companions); on fast-shadow live runs the same rows silently count as shadow FAILURES at row-write enrichment. FIX (core Agreement): documented WIRE_ROUNDING_TOLERANCE=0.02 — exact within 1e-6, renormalized within 0.02, loud failure beyond; 3 new AgreementTest cases at sweep time (+2 at close-out); full ./gradlew test green incl. the Tier A byte-identical drift check; verified live (runs 2+3 joined reads computed: coverage 1.0 and 0.379).

[decision-quality] Run 1: tap(TFA image -> #/media overlay) <-> back loop, 37 steps, never finish — the engine picked the image node (its label matches the TFA title) instead of the article link and alternating actions evade every stuck signal. Budget bounded it. Architectural (stuck-detector design is vision 04 s4) — reported, not fixed.

[decision-quality] Run 2: consent-wall blindness — 'Accept All'/'Reject All' enumerated but never considered (p<=0.05) while a consent-blocked 'Search' submit repeated 5x (p up to 0.77); the L1 hint text did not change the choice. Real-web UAT implication: consent-walled sites need either a swap-site rule or engine guidance. Architectural — reported.

[decision-quality]+[ux-friction] Run 3: target=_blank story links are dropped by webview_shell (no multi-window) — tap executes, nothing happens, engine retries; one recovery cycle fired then dynamic-page text changes kept the stuck window below threshold. Site choice for UAT should favor same-window navigators (Wikipedia works). Architectural/environment — reported.

[a11y-quality] POSITIVE: real-page observation was excellent all session — 10-25 candidates/step, correct URL reads (incl. fragments), deterministic enumeration, ZERO starvation on real sites (contrast: gate63's all-starved session). The M0 loop's observation layer holds on real web pages.

[environment] Loopback starvation inversion: this AVD session exposed REAL sites but never loopback pages (pageNodes=2 across warm-up 3/3 launches + stub attempts), while gate63 saw both starved; HarnessPagesServer verified serving bytes (adb forward + curl). Warm-up primes on loopback home.html and never succeeded — priming warm-up with a real site is a candidate harness improvement (not changed this sweep).
[none] HarnessActivity shadow-settle log line computed percentiles over UNSORTED latencies (log vs report disagreed) — FIXED (sorted; harness-only).

[budget][gate] POSITIVE: TaskBudget enforced on real provider numbers ($0.25 hard stop fired twice, soft $0.20 warned+logged first); auto-deny headless mode produced 0 gate events (no H-class action was attempted on these sites); every terminal (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/STUCK_KILL/REFUSED) clean; 0 log gaps across 73 live rows + 12 stub rows; 0 wire-protocol/transport exceptions; no ANRs.
fixesApplied: core Agreement.kt: WIRE_ROUNDING_TOLERANCE=0.02 wire-rounding renormalization (see [wire] above); AgreementTest +4 cases
HarnessActivity.kt: sorted percentile inputs for the shadow-settle log line
GoalCatalog.customGoal + HarnessActivity custom-goal extras (harness-only, +4 GoalCatalogTest cases)
deviations: CUSTOM-GOAL HARNESS CAPABILITY (dispatch-directed, test tooling only): runtime-built goals bypass the goals.json fixture; LIVE-only enforced at launch; completion-guard semantics unchanged (triage still decides the class; lookup guard requires a contentful page beyond the first).

AGREEMENT TOLERANCE (product code in :core — the only non-harness change): vision 05 s3 pins no rounding tolerance; the strict 1e-6 assert predated live-wire data and made the ratified 8B joined view unusable on real rows. The fix keeps loud failure beyond 2%, is documented in KDoc + core/AGENTS.md, is unit-tested, and leaves fixture-replay values bitwise unchanged (exactly-normalized inputs scale by 1.0). Tier A drift artifacts byte-identical (drift test green).

SHADOW ON per dispatch despite the phase-6 blocker recommendation — accepted diagnostics risk; the SIGSEGV reproduced and is now characterized (settle/close race), strengthening the keep-shadow-OFF-on-this-AVD rule for everything except dedicated shadow gates.

Launch runbook deviation discovered: am start -S disables the app's enabled a11y service (platform behavior); the service must be re-put via settings inside the harness's 20s await window. Two early launches failed with service-not-enabled before the runbook was established ($0 spend). Recorded in app/AGENTS.md.
